observations: Actual runtime, cache, repositories and account/native resource owner identities are required; fixtureOnly is rejected.

Reader snapshots observe real native events and commit callbacks. Observer failures are caught; real mounted Reader regression restores 240, flushes 600 and detaches once both with and without a fixture document directory.
The bounded observer checks the current owned request, nonce, platform, device, run, input hash, timestamp and active owner before writing a separate record.
Development-only provider requires exact synthetic account, owned device/container and completed original adoption/default startup markers.
External forwarding and StoreKit operations are refused. Numeric snapshots exclude document text, selection content and credentials.
Empty UI host has no App Group or database access and activates only an already running guarded main app.
Implementation supports the approved genuine on-disk upgrade verification. No new optional dependencies were added.
Prepared XCTest and WebView existence cannot establish visible article, comment, restored-position or complete visual acceptance.

scope: Scoped review of controlled observation and UI-driver preparation before the actual native visible-upgrade run; not the final repository pre-push review.
